matthiesen_core.configuration.title: Matthiesen Core Configuration
matthiesen_core.configuration.common.dat: Configuration settings for data management in Matthiesen Core.
matthiesen_core.configuration.common.per: Configuration settings for permissions management in Matthiesen Core.

If enabled, Matthiesen Core will use the LuckPerms permission validator when LuckPerms is installed on the server. If disabled, Matthiesen Core will fallback to the loader's default permission validator or the VanillaPermissionValidator if no other validator is provided. This setting is only relevant when LuckPerms is installed on the server, and will be ignored if LuckPerms is not present.
